title: 和子由渑池怀旧
author: 苏轼
intro: What is a human life like? A wild goose landing on snowy mud: it leaves a few claw prints, then flies off without caring where. A young Su Shi writes this to his brother — and gives Chinese the idiom 雪泥鸿爪.
analysis: 这是苏轼回赠弟弟苏辙（字子由）的诗。五年前兄弟俩进京赶考，路过渑池，住在一座寺庙里，还在墙上题了诗；这次苏轼去凤翔做官，弟弟送别后写诗回忆渑池，苏轼就“和”了这首。前四句是有名的比喻：人这一生到处奔走，像什么呢？就像飞来的大雁踩在雪地的泥上，偶然留下几个爪印，飞走以后哪里还管东边西边。人生的足迹也是偶然、短暂的。成语“雪泥鸿爪”就出自这里。后四句回到渑池：当年招待他们的老和尚已经去世，只留下一座新的骨灰塔；墙也坏了，看不到当年题的诗。最后问弟弟：还记得那时路途的艰难吗？路很长，人很累，跛脚的驴还在叫。诗里有对人生无常的感叹，但语气平静，兄弟情很深。
analysisEn: Su Shi wrote this in reply to a poem from his younger brother Su Zhe (courtesy name Ziyou). Five years earlier the brothers, on their way to the imperial exams, had passed through Mianchi, stayed at a temple and written poems on its wall. Now Su Shi was leaving for his first post, and his brother wrote a poem remembering that town; this is Su Shi’s answer. The first four lines are a famous comparison: what is a life of travelling like? A wild goose landing on snowy mud — it leaves a few claw prints by chance, then flies away without a thought for east or west. Our traces in the world are just as accidental and brief. The idiom 雪泥鸿爪 (“a goose’s claw prints in snow and mud”) comes from here. The second half returns to Mianchi: the old monk who hosted them has died and now rests in a new pagoda; the wall has crumbled, and their poems are gone. Finally he asks his brother: do you still remember how hard that road was — the long way, our weariness, the lame donkey braying? It is a reflection on impermanence, told calmly, full of a brother’s affection.
background: Su Shi (1037–1101) wrote this in 1061, aged 25, on his way to his first official post at Fengxiang. In 1056 he and his brother Su Zhe had passed through Mianchi on the way to the capital; Su Shi’s own note says their horse died on the road and they rode a donkey the rest of the way.
pronunciation: 和 hè（依照别人诗的题材或韵律作诗，不读 hé）；渑池 Miǎnchí；应似 yīng；指爪 zhǐ zhǎo；那复 nǎ fù（那，同“哪”）；还记否 hái；蹇驴 jiǎn lǘ。机器朗读“应、爪、那、蹇”容易读错，已在“朗读用字”列换成同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行文本（《苏轼诗集》）。题目一作《和子由渑池怀旧》，原诗后有苏轼自注：“往岁，马死于二陵，骑驴至渑池。”

lines.py: rén shēng dào chù zhī hé sì
lines.lit: A human life, going everywhere — do you know what it is like?
lines.en: A life spent wandering from place to place — what is it like?

lines.py: yīng sì fēi hóng tà xuě ní
lines.lit: It should be like a flying goose treading on snowy mud.
lines.en: Like a wild goose that lands for a moment on snowy mud.

lines.py: ní shàng ǒu rán liú zhǐ zhǎo
lines.lit: On the mud by chance it leaves claw prints;
lines.en: By chance it leaves a few claw prints behind,

lines.py: hóng fēi nǎ fù jì dōng xī
lines.lit: the goose flies off — how would it still reckon east or west?
lines.en: then flies off, never caring whether east or west.

lines.py: lǎo sēng yǐ sǐ chéng xīn tǎ
lines.lit: The old monk has died and become a new pagoda;
lines.en: The old monk has died; a new pagoda holds his ashes.

lines.py: huài bì wú yóu jiàn jiù tí
lines.lit: on the ruined wall there is no way to see our old inscriptions.
lines.en: The wall has crumbled; the poems we wrote there are gone.

lines.py: wǎng rì qí qū hái jì fǒu
lines.lit: The rough going of those days — do you still remember?
lines.en: Do you still remember how hard that road was —

lines.py: lù cháng rén kùn jiǎn lǘ sī
lines.lit: The road long, the people weary, the lame donkey braying.
lines.en: the endless miles, our weariness, the lame donkey braying?

words.en: to write a poem in reply to another’s
words.note: 古代文人互相赠诗唱和；现代汉语“一唱百和”“附和”仍读 hè。

words.en: Ziyou, courtesy name of Su Zhe
words.note: 苏轼的弟弟苏辙，字子由。
书面语，现代汉语说“没办法”。

words.en: old inscriptions (poems written on the wall)
words.note: 古人常在寺庙墙上题诗。
现代汉语仍用，如“崎岖的山路”。
蹇：跛脚、走不快，今天不用。
现代汉语“嘶叫”“声嘶力竭”。

words.en: a goose’s prints in snowy mud — faint traces of the past
words.note: 从这首诗来的成语，今天仍用，比喻往事留下的痕迹。

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 飞鸿（大雁）踩雪泥、留爪印又飞走，比喻人生行踪偶然而短暂。
imagery.en: The wild goose that lands, leaves prints and flies on is an image of a human life: our traces are accidental and brief.

imagery.name: 雪
imagery.zh: 雪泥上的爪印很快会消失，暗示一切痕迹都留不长久。
imagery.en: Prints in snowy mud soon vanish — nothing we leave behind lasts long.

imagery.name: 路
imagery.zh: 当年赶考路长人困，崎岖的路是兄弟共同的记忆，也是人生艰难的象征。
imagery.en: The long, rough road to the exams is a memory the brothers share — and a picture of life’s hardships.
